name: koya_gooface
desc: Keep the same character exactly: the same head shape, ears, hair, mane, muzzle, body size and colors. Change only this: he throws his head back and tilts it up toward the sky, the mouth opens wide with thick sticky strings of paint stretching between the upper and lower jaw and dripping down the chin and neck, the eyes are shut. His whole body is still melting and dripping heavily with thick paint, the arms hang limp, and the legs are still merged into a wide puddle of the same paint on the floor. Same cream pattern, outline and pixel art style.
